adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Discourse.Group#addMembers` and `#removeMember` only handling success via `.then(...)` (reloading members) with no error/rejection handling or user feedback on failure (e.g., 404/422/500). Additionally, the admin controller action `addMembers` explicitly contains `// TODO: should clear the input` and does not clear `this.get("usernames")`, so re-clicking will resend the same usernames string. These are real, diff-grounded UX/robustness gaps, but not a strictly verifiable functional defect since failing requests simply don’t update state (default behavior).
